# Bozzmail

> Encrypted, ad-free email with a private calendar and contacts. No tracking. Bozzmail is pre-launch: visitors can reserve their @bozzmail.com address and receive a launch invite.

## What Bozzmail is
- End-to-end, zero-knowledge encrypted email, calendar and contacts
- No ads, no tracking, no profiling
- Apps planned for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux and the browser
- Hosting powered by renewable energy

## Who it is for
- Privacy-conscious individuals
- Businesses, medical practices, activists and journalists who need confidential communication

## Key pages
- https://bozzmail.com/ — landing page: product overview, security approach, planned plan tiers, FAQ and the @bozzmail.com address reservation form
